notes: Repair from OneNote has a clear name

entries.title: Repair from OneNote has a clear name
entries.detail:
In Settings › OneNote, Broken tables is now Repair from OneNote. It says what it repairs: a table that fell apart into loose lines, or "
" shown as text.

entries.title: New versions arrive while folia stays open
entries.detail: folia looks for a new version each time it comes back into view, so the menu bar app does not keep an old one for days. In Settings, Done has the size and font of the other buttons.

entries.title: ⌘H hides folia again
entries.detail: ⌘H hides folia, ⌥⌘H hides the other apps. And every button and choice in Settings now has the same size, colours and type.

entries.title: The Mac app to download, also in the Mac app
entries.detail: Settings › Mac app in the Mac app also offers the newest folia for Mac to download, for another Mac.

entries.title: folia in the menu bar, with a hotkey
entries.detail: The Mac app has an icon in the menu bar, with Open folia and Open in Browser. ⌃⌥⌘F opens folia from any app, and hides it again. Settings › Mac app sets the hotkey, where folia shows its icon (menu bar, Dock, or both), and Open at login.

entries.title: Left pages leave the list once fixed
entries.detail: Settings › OneNote › Left as they are no longer lists a page once it is copied fresh from OneNote: it goes at once, not only at the next daily update.

entries.title: Text after a OneNote video kept
entries.detail: Copy fresh from OneNote keeps the text that follows a video embedded in OneNote as text. Before, it showed as HTML code.

entries.title: Tables inside OneNote tables
entries.detail:
Copy fresh from OneNote keeps a table that OneNote has inside a table cell: its cells become lines of that cell, pictures too. Before, the row broke apart and "
" showed as text. Settings › OneNote › Broken tables counts and repairs such pages too.

entries.title: Pictures with brackets in their caption kept
entries.detail: Copy fresh from OneNote keeps a picture whose caption has a lone "[" or "]". OneNote writes the text it reads in a picture into its caption. Before, such a picture became text.

entries.title: Pictures in OneNote tables kept
entries.detail: Copy fresh from OneNote keeps a picture in a table cell whose caption has a "|", and text with a "|" stays in its cell. Before, the picture became text.

entries.title: ETH daily update in Settings
entries.detail: Settings › OneNote calls the daily 20:00 update of your ETH notebooks "ETH daily update", with "Update now", in place of "Runs".

entries.title: Repair broken tables from OneNote
entries.detail: Settings › OneNote counts the pages whose OneNote table came in broken, ETH and NZZ and SRG SSR alike, and repairs them in one run: each page is copied fresh from OneNote, one after the other. A page with lines of your own stays as it is and is listed.

entries.title: Files in table cells as file cards
entries.detail: A file that OneNote keeps in a table cell now shows as a file card in that cell, with its size, like any file on a page. A file within a sentence stays a link.

entries.title: Files in table cells open
entries.detail: A file that stands in a table cell, as OneNote puts files in tables, opens with a click, like a file card. Wide tables are saved without padding, so their Markdown stays small.

entries.title: Tables from OneNote keep their rows
entries.detail: A OneNote table whose cells hold several lines or a list now comes in as a table, each line of a cell on its own line. A line break you make in a table cell stays after saving.

entries.title: ETH OneNote and Private OneNote in Settings
entries.detail: Settings › OneNote names both of your OneNote accounts alike: ETH OneNote, which comes in every day at 20:00, and Private OneNote, for your NZZ and SRG SSR notebooks.

entries.title: Copy fresh from OneNote, also for NZZ and SRG SSR
entries.detail: Pages of your NZZ and SRG SSR notebooks can be copied fresh from OneNote too, as ETH pages are. Connect your private OneNote once in Settings › OneNote. folia reads a page there only when you ask; nothing comes in by itself.

entries.title: Copy a page fresh from OneNote
entries.detail: A page from your ETH notebooks has “Copy fresh from OneNote” in its menu in the page list. It brings the page as OneNote has it now, with its pictures and files where they stand. If the page has lines OneNote does not have, folia asks first. History keeps the page as it was.

entries.title: The opened page at the top of the page list
entries.detail: A page opened by a link, by search or by ⌘O now stands at the top of the page list, not at its bottom. A page you click in the list stays where it is.

entries.title: The open page shows in the page list
entries.detail: Open a page by a link, by search or by ⌘O, and the page list scrolls to it, so you see where it stands.

entries.title: Zooming keeps the page’s width
entries.detail: A pinch, ⌘+ or ⌘− makes the page’s text larger or smaller; the page itself keeps filling its width. Before, it became narrower or wider with the zoom.

entries.title: The page uses its whole width
entries.detail: The text and tables of a page now fill the space they have: more when a side panel is closed, and all of it when the page is shown alone, so wide tables show whole.

entries.title: A click on a link opens it
entries.detail: In a page, a click on a web link opens it in your default browser, a mail link in your mail app, and a link to a folia page opens that page. Before, a click only placed the cursor.

entries.title: YouTube videos play in the page
entries.detail: Paste a YouTube link on a line of its own and it becomes a player. The Markdown copy keeps the video as its link.

entries.title: The page back to 100%
entries.detail: ⌘0 sets the page back to 100%; ⌘+ and ⌘− make it larger and smaller, as in Safari. When the page is not at 100%, the status bar shows its size: a click on it sets it back.

entries.title: Updates show at once
entries.detail: When a new version of folia has come, folia reloads once and uses it. Before, the new version showed only from the second start.

entries.title: The Mac app's What's New looks like this one, and its About has Docs
entries.detail: In the Mac app, What's New shows a card for each day, as here. When you check for updates and one is there, its changes show in the same window, with Install and Relaunch. About folia has a Docs button: it opens the folia Field Manual.

entries.title: Each notebook opens on your last page
entries.detail: Switch to another notebook and back: folia opens the page you had open there, as long as it is still there.

entries.title: Pinch to zoom on every page; the page alone, with the bars
entries.detail: Pinch on the trackpad to make any page larger or smaller. The button in the top bar now hides the side columns and keeps the top bar and the status bar; click it again to bring them back. No more full screen.

entries.title: Notebooks start in their right order and colours
entries.detail: At the start folia showed an old copy of your notebooks for a moment, in an old order and old colours. It now keeps that copy where there is room, and never shows an old one.

entries.title: Pictures in tables can grow past their cell
entries.detail: Drag a picture’s corner in a table: it may pass its cell, and its column widens to hold it when you let go.

entries.title: Copy a page’s link with a right click
entries.detail: A right click on a page in the list opens its menu; Copy link puts the page’s address on the clipboard, to paste anywhere.

entries.title: Page only, on the whole screen
entries.detail: The new button in the top bar shows the page alone, without the side columns and bars, on the whole screen. Pinch on the trackpad to make it larger or smaller; Esc leaves.

entries.title: Several files attach reliably
entries.detail: Files you pick, drop or paste all land below your line, in their order, also when the page changes while they upload. Before, sometimes not a single one was attached.

entries.title: Search and the calendar stay quick on very long lines
entries.detail: A page or a meeting invitation with a very long run of spaces could make folia stop answering. Search and the meeting pages now read such lines at once.

entries.title: No more freezes from the Markdown copy
entries.detail: A page with a very wide table made folia stop answering for about a minute each time it saved its Markdown copy. It now saves such a page at once.

entries.title: More pages find their place when updating
entries.detail: Copies of one page, pages renamed in folia and OneNote’s empty year pages now find their folia page: in ⌘K › Update pages from a folder, and in the daily OneNote import.

entries.title: Update pages from a folder ignores list numbers
entries.detail: A page whose numbered list folia renumbered is no longer left as changed by you.

entries.title: Docs and What's new in About folia
entries.detail: Settings › About folia opens the folia Field Manual, on what folia is and how it works, and lists what changed in folia, newest first, as j4k does.

entries.title: St., ca. and Mo. stay at a line start
entries.detail: A line that starts with a short word and a dot, like "St. Gallen" or "ca. 40", no longer turns into a numbered list that drops the word.
